text: Recent bad deployment or config change in feature-service :: A new version or configuration of service:gridcast:feature-service introduced a regression that causes unhandled exceptions on a subset of requests. :: Most likely because the 5xx spike is isolated to feature-service and aligns with a change window.

Resource exhaustion in feature-service :: Thread pool or connection pool saturation inside service:gridcast:feature-service caused requests to be rejected with 5xx errors. :: Likely if the spike correlates with a traffic increase or increased request latency.

Downstream dependency failure :: A downstream service called by service:gridcast:feature-service began timing out or returning errors, which feature-service surfaced as 5xx responses. :: Plausible if downstream error or latency metrics correlate with the incident window.

Database backing feature-service degraded :: Slow queries or database connection saturation caused service:gridcast:feature-service to exhaust its DB connection pool and fail requests with 5xx. :: Likely if database latency or connection errors spiked during the same period.

Load balancer or network path issue :: A load balancer misroute or failed health check caused a subset of service:gridcast:feature-service nodes to receive invalid requests or return 5xx. :: Possible if the issue was node-specific or if other services on the same load balancer were also affected.
